subject: Summit16 badge capture — live sync & consent wording
messages:
From: Sophie Ramirez <sophie.ramirez@summit16.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Hwang <thwang@expoops.io>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Summit16 — badge capture feed & consent language

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for confirming Redwood will be our lead capture sponsor at Summit16. A couple of operational items so our tech team can wire up the feed: 

- Can your scanners post a realtime event (webhook) for every badge-scan, or do you prefer batch CSV exports? We support both, but our on-site partner (ExpoOps) prefers webhooks for lower latency.
- What HubSpot properties would you like us to populate on ingest? We can map to standard lead fields or accept a custom JSON payload.
- Attached is the Summit16 API spec and our preferred consent placement on the registration flow. If you have alternate consent text required by your legal team, please send it back so we can display exactly what attendees agreed to.

Attachments: summit16_api_specs.pdf (PDF), registration-consent-sample.png (PNG)

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Ramirez
Partnerships Manager, Summit16
S: @sophie_r

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: Sophie Ramirez <sophie.ramirez@summit16.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit16 — badge capture feed & consent language

Hi Sophie — great to kick this off. Quick answers and requests from our side: 

- Preferred flow: realtime webhook to our intake endpoint for primary ingress; fallback to hourly batch CSV if connection drops. Webhook must deliver a unique scan_id, badge_id, timestamp, and a small payload for contact fields (email, first_name, last_name) when available.
- HubSpot mapping: we want standard mapping + one custom property: redwood_event_source = "summit16-boothA". Can you accept a JSON payload with a top-level "source_context" field?
- Consent: our legal has tightened opt-in language; I attached our recommendation (consent_language_v2.docx). We need the copy visible on the Scan UI and stored as consent_snapshot with the scan record.

Operational asks for ExpoOps/Tom: please confirm the webhook URL and whether TLS client certs are supported. Ben, Marissa — can you review the attached consent text and make quick edits? Marissa, can you also own mapping to HubSpot?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: consent_language_v2.docx (DOCX)

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Hwang <thwang@expoops.io>, Sophie Ramirez <sophie.ramirez@summit16.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit16 — badge capture feed & consent language

Looping in a few technical notes after looking at the spec and our infra constraints: 

- Webhook shape we can accept (JSON):
  - scan_id (string)
  - badge_id (string)
  - timestamp_utc (ISO8601)
  - attendee: {email, first_name, last_name} (email optional)
  - source_context (string)
  - consent_snapshot (string): full text of the consent shown at scan time

- Security: we can support TLS + HMAC signature (X-Rdwd-Signature) for payload verification. If ExpoOps can sign using a shared secret, we'll verify server-side.

- HubSpot mapping details (Marissa): please map:
  - attendee.email -> hs_email
  - attendee.first_name -> firstname
  - attendee.last_name -> lastname
  - source_context -> redwood_event_source (create custom property if missing)
  - consent_snapshot -> notes (we recommend storing into a single-line text custom property consent_snapshot)

- Edge cases: scans for attendees without email should create a lead with a placeholder (scan_+badge_id@redwood-temp.local) and mark as "email_missing" stage. We can assign to the event queue for follow-up.

Attachments: qrcode_layout_v1.png (PNG)

Ben Carter
Event Systems Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Sophie Ramirez <sophie.ramirez@summit16.com>, Tom Hwang <thwang@expoops.io>, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit16 — badge capture feed & consent language

Thanks everyone — quick operational plan and next steps: 

1) Export/ingest plan
   - IF webhook: ExpoOps to POST to https://ingest.redwoodinference.com/events/summit16 (TLS + HMAC). Ben to provision secret and share to Tom via our secrets flow.
   - FALLBACK: hourly CSV to SFTP (Ben will provide creds).

2) HubSpot mapping implemented
   - I created the custom property redwood_event_source and a single-line text consent_snapshot draft. We'll run a mapping test on 8/25 with a synthetic feed.

3) Consent copy
   - We edited Kimberly's doc to shorten the on-screen copy for clarity; full legal text will be attached to the record as consent_snapshot. Attached final screen copy in the thread.

4) On-site QA
   - Ben and Grace will be on-site at Summit16 for the first two days (setup + smoke tests).

5) Open items
   - Tom: can ExpoOps sign webhook payloads with HMAC? If not, can they add a static client cert?
   - Sophie: please confirm final placement of the short consent text on the scan UI by EOD 8/22.

Thanks — I'll owner the HubSpot test and the post-event ingest report.

Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Ops
Redwood Inference
